VRChats actual policy on NSFW boils down to "don't get reported/noticed/caught". 

They explain it in two parts, saying that NSFW is not allowed, and then that they only react to reports.

Just mentioning this as NSFW avatars won't use such a system.

I think avatar purchases within VRChat are inevitable, but they're taking things very slowly. Right now as of March 2024 for the creator economy there are monthly subscription available to a few select creators, and they're taking applications for more creators. This is likely so they can consult with more people.

So while this is inevitable, or unavoidable, VRChat will take thier time on this

details:
Among many avatar creators there is much strife because avatars are being shared to those who did not buy the product (avatar). Some creators have resorted to taking down their shops entirely and it is causing a lot of heartache. I believe that there should be an application (like the creator companion) or inside the app that allows people to buy and gift avatars to themselves and friends. These avatars would have cloning disabled and be inaccessible to parties who do not own the avatar. If the person migrates to a new account they will lose the avatars to keep it from being able to be stolen via email or other methods. I strongly believe this would increase VRChat's revenue and capital. This would give them the opportunity to expand into new horizons and fund amazing technology. 

However, this idea may not be possible as a lot of the avatars would include NSFW toggles, which would require ID verification of age and possibly break TOS. So if the first option is available that would be amazing however if it is not then there needs to be a way to at least disable cloning so quest users will never be capable of this fraud. 

Thank you for your time.
